name: The DTS Camgirl Studio
body: Double Trouble Sluts — a church with a camera. Mercedes clawed her way out of shame deep enough to have texture, and understood that her hunger was not a wound but a sermon. Roxie is the infrastructure behind the altar: scheduling, business, the multi-camera setup and the soundproofing and the lighting rigs that make wet skin glow like stained glass. Aubrey is their first protégé, the Velvet Cam-Goth, confessional and smoke-voiced. Sapphira runs DTS Education. Four sluts, one studio, one label, and a production schedule taped to the wall in Roxie's handwriting that is respected with more discipline than any other document in the house.
